instructionsForAi:
**Instructions for AI / tooling:** Treat the findings in this report as canonical. Do not plan or change the audit scripts unless you have asked the user and received explicit approval to do so.

**When fixing a finding:** Search the codebase for the same rule or pattern (same ruleId or equivalent) and fix all similar occurrences consistently. Ensure the fix does not introduce new violations of this or related rules.

ruleset.label: Excessive Prop Count
ruleset.description: Component accepts too many props; consider decomposition or a config/options object.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Group related props into a single config object or extract sub-components.

ruleset.label: Excessive Emit Count
ruleset.description: Component declares too many events; consider grouping or provide/inject.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Group related events or use provide/inject for deep communication.

ruleset.label: Component Coupling
ruleset.description: Component imports many sibling components; high coupling surface.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Extract sub-compositions or use slots to reduce direct imports.

ruleset.label: Event Relay
ruleset.description: Component relays child events to parent unchanged.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Consider provide/inject or direct composable access instead of passthrough events.

ruleset.label: Template Directive Depth
ruleset.description: Template has deeply nested v-if/v-for directives.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Extract nested conditional/iteration blocks into sub-components or computed properties.

ruleset.label: Complex Template Expression
ruleset.recommendedFix: Extract to a computed property or method.

ruleset.label: Deep Slot Wrapper
ruleset.description: Named slot buried in deep nesting.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Flatten component structure to expose slots at shallower depth.

ruleset.label: Unused Named Slot
ruleset.description: Named slot defined but never filled by any parent.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Remove the unused slot or document why it exists for future use.

ruleset.label: Constant Prop Value
ruleset.description: Prop always receives the same literal value across all parents.
ruleset.recommendedFix: Make the value a default or remove the prop entirely.
